annotations.description: Activated Chandra's Magmutt's tap ability for 1 damage instead of attacking. The opponent's Lightning Visionary has summoning sickness and can't attack but CAN block - however, if opponent blocks with the 2/1 Visionary, it's a mutual trade that removes a prowess threat. If unblocked, Magmutt deals 2 damage instead of 1. Either outcome (2 damage or removing Visionary) is better than 1 damage from the tap ability. Additionally, a land should be played first before taking other actions.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Chandra's Magmutt tap ability for 1 damage before playing a land or entering combat
annotations.betterLine: Play an Island first, then go to combat and attack with Chandra's Magmutt for 2 damage (or trade with Lightning Visionary)

annotations.description: Used Chandra's +1 discard/exile ability with all lands tapped, meaning no exiled cards could be played this turn. This effectively discarded the entire hand (including Chandra's Incinerator, a powerful 6/6 trampler that could be cast cheaply in future turns using Magmutt's noncombat damage) for nothing.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Chandra's +1 discard hand/exile 3 ability with zero mana available, throwing away Aegis Turtle, Chandra's Incinerator, and Island.
annotations.betterLine: Use Chandra's +1 deal 2 damage to kill Lightning Visionary (removing an attacking threat with prowess) or deal 2 to the opponent's face. Keep the hand intact, especially Chandra's Incinerator which could be cast cheaply on a future turn after dealing noncombat damage with Magmutt and Chandra.

annotations.description: Casting Pillar of Flame in precombat main phase when all opponent creatures are tapped. Chandra's Magmutt could attack for a free 2 damage first, then Pillar could be cast postcombat. There's no benefit to casting Pillar precombat (no prowess creatures on their side, no need to clear blockers since opponent's board is tapped).
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Pillar of Flame in precombat main phase before attacking
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Chandra's Magmutt first (free 2 damage since all opponent creatures are tapped), then cast Pillar of Flame postcombat. This preserves information and guarantees the extra combat damage.

annotations.description: Player passed priority in precombat main with an empty hand and Chandra, Heart of Fire at 3 loyalty available. Chandra's +1 discard/exile ability with an empty hand is essentially a free 'draw 3' (exile top 3, play them this turn) that also increases loyalty. With no hand, the discard cost is literally zero. The player also failed to activate Chandra's Magmutt for 1 damage. Passing here wastes the entire turn's card advantage potential while behind on resources.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the precombat main phase without activating any abilities.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Chandra, Heart of Fire's +1 (discard hand/exile 3) to get access to 3 cards this turn for free, then potentially play exiled cards with available mana. Also consider activating Magmutt for 1 damage before or after combat.

annotations.description: MstLg Trash declined to attack with Chandra's Magmutt when the opponent had zero untapped blockers. This was 2 free damage with no risk. The opponent was at 16 life, so every point of damage matters.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed on attacking, dealing 0 combat damage.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Chandra's Magmutt for 2 unblocked damage, bringing the opponent from 16 to 14 life.

annotations.description: Passed the turn without activating Chandra, Heart of Fire's +1 discard/exile ability while having an empty hand. This would have been a free 'draw 3' (exile top 3 and play them this turn) with 3 untapped lands plus Unstable Obelisk available to cast anything found. Also missed free ping damage from Chandra's Magmutt. With an empty hand and no cards to play, using Chandra to generate card advantage was critical.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with no actions taken in postcombat main.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Chandra, Heart of Fire's +1 (discard hand, exile top 3) to find playable cards with the 3+ available mana. Then also tap Chandra's Magmutt to deal 1 damage to the opponent for free incremental damage.

annotations.description: Filigree Attendant (2/3) can block Chandra's Magmutt (2/2) and survive, killing the Magmutt for free. The Magmutt is a persistent threat with its tap-to-deal-1-damage ability and as a 2/2 attacker. Not blocking means taking 2 unnecessary damage and leaving the Magmutt alive when it could be killed at no cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block Chandra's Magmutt with Filigree Attendant, taking 2 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Block Chandra's Magmutt with Filigree Attendant to kill the Magmutt while the Attendant survives at 2/1. This removes a persistent damage source for free.
